questions.q: Who was the first person the Prophet SAW taught to pray?
questions.explain: Jibril taught wudu and prayer, and Khadijah was the first to be taught.

questions.q: What did Ali do before pronouncing the shahada?
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW allowed Ali time to think. Give room for thought.

questions.q: Who accepted Islam immediately without hesitation?
questions.explain: Abu Bakr was the close friend who did not hesitate.

questions.q: What expertise of Abu Bakr helped the da'wah?
options: Genealogy, the knowledge of lineage and tribal relations
questions.explain: Abu Bakr used his network and integrity.

questions.q: Why was the house of Al-Arqam chosen as a headquarters?
options: It lay in the clan of Abu Jahal, which was not suspected
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW built a base before announcing publicly.

questions.q: You have not been praying. What does this lecture advise?
options: It is never too late to start today
questions.explain: Whoever has not prayed can begin today.

questions.q: A large number is a sign of truth.
questions.explain: False. Many or few is not the measure of truth.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW allowed Ali time to think before embracing Islam.
Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The house of Al-Arqam becomes a base

questions.explain: Khadijah, Ali, Zayd, Abu Bakr, then the house of Al-Arqam became a base.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The base of da'wah, the house of Al-Arqam
Da'wah not announced to the public
Knowledge of lineage and tribal relations
The strangers, who hold to the truth when the majority deviates

questions.explain: Genealogy is the knowledge of lineage, a markaz is the base of da'wah, ghuraba' are the strangers who hold to the truth, and closed da'wah is not announced publicly.
